headline: Growth of the tourism sector and review of Law 158-01
summary: Enrique E. De Marchena Kaluche, a former president of the Dominican hotel and tourism association, argues that growth in the tourism industry requires updating the legislation that governs the sector. He also called for provisions protecting tourists' rights.
why: Tourism is a major source of foreign currency and employment for the Dominican Republic, so changes to its governing rules affect hotel operators and the wider economy.
original_headline: Crecimiento sector turístico y revisión Ley 158-01
